agentSelect.messageTarget: Agent that will receive the message: {{name}}

mic.voiceType: Type by voice ({{language}} · {{engine}}) — change the language in Settings
mic.microphoneUnavailable: microphone access is unavailable (a secure context is required)

errors.serviceNotAllowed: the speech recognition service is unavailable

send.interruptTitle: Interrupt the turn and send now (Ctrl/Cmd+Enter)
send.steerTitle: Guide the current task without stopping it
send.steerUnavailable: Live guidance is unavailable for this turn. Use Queue instead.

ask.label: Ask
ask.hint: Ask for approval before writing or running commands

tools.title: Tools

descriptions.inContext: The full schemas for these tools are sent to the model on every turn, so it can call them immediately.
descriptions.onDemand: The schemas for these tools are not sent with the turn; the agent loads them through tool_search / activate_tools when needed. {{hiddenCount}} are in the Hidden tier: they are not listed individually in the catalog, while context retains only a note that they can be found with tool_search.
descriptions.servers: All MCP servers in the workspace, including scoped servers, and whether their tools enter context: green means present in the prompt; yellow or gray means absent (hover over the badge for the reason). 🔗 marks a live connection. Select a row to inspect that server's tools; search filters expanded rows. Configuration is available in Settings under Tools.

empty.inContext: This agent has no tools whose schemas are sent on every turn.
empty.onDemand: No tools are available on demand — all tools are already in context.
empty.noServers: No MCP servers are configured in this workspace.

tools.mcpDisabled: MCP is disabled for this agent, so tools from MCP servers are unavailable.

full.label: Full
full.hint: The full schema is sent to the agent on every turn (highest token cost).

summary.label: Summary
summary.hint: The catalog shows the name and a short summary; the full schema loads on demand.

nameOnly.label: Name
nameOnly.hint: Only the name appears in the catalog; the schema loads through tool_search/activate_tools.

hidden.label: Hidden
hidden.hint: Not listed in the catalog; discoverable only through tool_search and callable after activation.

inContext.label: in context
inContext.hint: This server's tools are in the agent's prompt and can be called.

hiddenOnly.label: outside catalog
hiddenOnly.hint: Its tools use the Hidden tier: they are not listed individually, but context retains a note that more tools can be found with tool_search. They can be called normally after activation.

disabled.label: disabled
disabled.hint: The server is disabled in this workspace and can be enabled from the Tools screen.

agentMcpOff.label: MCP off for agent
agentMcpOff.hint: The server is enabled, but MCP is disabled for this agent, so no MCP tools are provided.

noTools.label: no tools
noTools.hint: The server is enabled but supplies no tools. It may be disconnected or all its tools may be blocked.

server.activeHint: Number of tools from this server whose FULL schema is sent on every turn
server.catalogHint: Number of tools listed by name or summary that can be opened with activate_tools
server.hiddenHint: Number of tools not listed individually in the catalog; context retains only a note that they can be found with tool_search (about {{tokens}} tokens saved per turn for {{value}} tools).
